book.name: 2 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Labuina Pol wana Leleli

content: Pol Kolinita I Ba Pagasisel wali Pagan Nihi Hile

Nowa toto ya, no nowa paetonina te ya nonowa eliyamiu. He sauga ebo na nowa ge gamagalau bolo hi gegi ali nuwatu ta pasapu, nasi ta ginol ni ola Buki Bwabwalena ana baaba, toto i ba, “Gamagalau labui o ebo eton nihi ba, ‘E, ha kite,’ mulaa abwe woliwoli etegana ta patunahot.”

Valila no nowa paeluwana elana iyaka ya ba haba bolo wali gegi toto valila iyoho ya hi awaawaginol elal. Inoke sauga ya o bwaga i yapu eliyamiu, na ba elal ge gamagalau gegewel al elal na ba, “Sauga ebo na nowa al, togegi nige wali gegi na nunuwayoho bwabwage, he ali lahi nige ni kakala.”
Ku ba, “Nu pankitema inoke naha atena tunahot Keliso i baaba anam elana.” He na nowa yaka gegewena abwe nuku atena! Keliso nige i pwepweyata te ni lahemiu, i gasisi te i tuwalaliya gamwamiwa.

Tunahot pweyata eliyana Keliso hi lokolosan, yaa Yehoba wana gasisi eliyana yaka sauga ya yawalina i gan. He ama ha minaa elana ge ha pweyata, yaa Yehoba wana gasisi elana aloma iya yawalima i gan, ge gasisi o naha patuwalali gamwamiwa.

Nuku labosemiu tab ku nanawaa abulilek ana kamwasa elana. Totomiu wami pagan nuku hile. Ku atena Yeisu Keliso i minaa eliyamiu, age? E i minaa eliyamiu, yaa ebo wami pagan nanakina kaiwena nuku sogu, he nigeya.
(He ateu i matuwa te ebo ama wama ginol nuku hile, nuku pwawama ama Keliso wana totuwalali tutunahotil.)

Inoke ha awanun Yehoba elana ni labemiu ge bahi gegi paganina etega nuku giginol. Yaa nige ha loloyaan te tage gamagalau nihi awa totuwalali waiwaisal-agima. Bwagana ebo gamagalau nihi kitema tage ama nige totuwalali waiwaisal i oola, he nige ha nuwanuwatu-an. Wama nuwatu hot te komiu pagan waiwaisana nuku awaawaginol.

Nige ha loloyaan te tage gamagalau nihi awa wawaisi-agima, kaiwena nige bosowaima bugul etega naha ginol ge tage wasa tutunahotina naha pihigelgel-an, ha talamwagima ya te wasa tutunahotina naha labe.
He ebo ama ha pweyata ge komiu ku gasisi, ama ha yaliyaya-an to. Inoke ha awanun Yehoba elana ni labemiu yaka yawalimiu ana nawanawa ni waisi hot.

O bwaga i yapu eliyamiu ge leta ya ya leleli puna i ola hiwe. Sauga ebo na nowa, bahi togegi na pwapwawal ge no gasisi elana ali lahi na giginol. Babala gasisi i pem wana tuwalali na matahikan, he nuwau gasisi o na patuwalali wami abulilek ana taltal kaiwena, nige ami apapanak kaiwena i oola.

Taliwau ge nuwau, no nuwatu ana siga inoke na ba, “Eeu, kaiyoni!” Nuku gasisi inoke yawalimiu ana nawanawa elana ni waisi hot. No ba pagapagasisi leta ya elana nuku hago. Wami nuwatu ni maisena ge nuku mibubun, inoke nunuwana ge mibubun ana Yabowaine ni minaa alomiu sauga gegewena.
Nimamiu nuku paelu alomiyau elal ge nuku pemumulolu-agimiu, kaiwena komiu Yehoba wana gamagalau.
Toabulilek gegewel labi ya elana hi mulolu eliyamiu.
Babala Yeisu Keliso wana mulolu, Yehoba wana nunuwana, ge Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana heliheliyam ni minaa ku gewigewi eliyamiu.
